important.name: TASK-4 release note still says Rejected after D5A renamed it Unchosen
important.summary:
TASK-4's action dictates the release-note line verbatim: 'lays out each decision as a block with Chosen and Rejected lists'. D5A (decision D5, chosen) and TASK-2's action say the opposite: the markers are Chosen, Unchosen and Open pills and 'the word Rejected no longer appears'. The design changes PR1 and PR2 in DesignEvolution.json list only TASK-2 in `items`, so the rename never reached TASK-4. A haiku executor following TASK-4 literally will write a GitHub release body (docs/RELEASES/v1.0.0.md) that describes the old wording and leaves out the pill markers. The rendered PIP repeats the stale sentence at line 148.

Also (overall): TASK-4's action dictates the exact release-note line for docs/RELEASES/v1.0.0.md: '... lays out each decision as a block with Chosen and Rejected lists ...'. That contradicts D5A and TASK-2, which rename Rejected to Unchosen and state 'the word Rejected no longer appears'. The planned test test_plan_render_html_decisions.py asserts '"Rejected" not in body'. DesignEvolution PR1 records the rename, but the change stopped at TASK-2 and never reached TASK-4. A haiku executor copies the line verbatim, so the shipped release notes would describe a label the page no longer shows. D3's question at line 319 ('listed under Chosen and Rejected') uses the same old wording, and that text becomes an h3 on the rendered page.

Also (docs): TASK-4 tells the README to say that an existing page 'keeps its old layout until it is deleted and PLAN render <id> writes it again'. refresh_pip (plugins/harness/lib/harness_lib/plan_render_html.py:211-223 at base) says otherwise: freeze, freeze --refreeze and plan_api.write all rewrite an existing page through write_pip. So a refreeze or any plan_api.write also moves the page to the new layout, and the README sentence will understate that.
fix: Through plan_api.write and a refreeze, change the TASK-4 release line to '... lays out each decision as a block with Chosen and Unchosen (or Open) lists under status-badge pill markers, themes headings and code, ...', and add TASK-4 to the `items` of PR1 in docs/plans/1020/DesignEvolution.json through evolution_api so the change cites every item it touched.

Through the plan driver, change the TASK-4 action's release-note line to '... a block with Chosen and Unchosen lists ...', optionally reword the D3 question to 'Chosen and Unchosen', add a DesignEvolution entry naming TASK-4, then refreeze (r1.5).
Leave the frozen text as it is and have the TASK-4 executor record a deviation that writes 'Chosen and Unchosen lists' in docs/RELEASES/v1.0.0.md.

Through plan_api.write, change the TASK-4 README sentence to: an existing page keeps its old layout until the next freeze --refreeze or plan_api.write rewrites it, or until it is deleted and PLAN render <id> writes it again.

minor.name: D3 question still names the Rejected list
minor.summary: D3 asks 'How are a decision's options listed under Chosen and Rejected (issue 278)?'. Its question predates D5A, and since D5A the second list is labelled Unchosen. The rendered PIP shows the stale label at line 40, right above D5, which says Rejected no longer appears.
fix: Through plan_api.write, reword the D3 question to 'listed under Chosen and Unchosen', then refreeze.
Leave the D3 question as historical wording, and have D5's rationale note that it renamed the D3 label.
